boundary_findings.runtime: Runtime.Acquire remains a separate fixed controller path; the new adaptive runtime was a wrapper, not the core acquisition controller.
boundary_findings.method_artifact: AcquisitionMethodArtifact had executable-looking metadata but Procedure was interpreted by a hard-coded switch over procedure names.
boundary_findings.method_generator: GenerateMethodCandidates was a hand-authored bottleneck-to-method table.
boundary_findings.method_evaluator: verifyMethodCandidate executed named procedures and used UniversalMechanismSearch; evaluator was independent of candidate selection but method semantics were privileged.
boundary_findings.installation: InstalledMethodRegistry persisted method metadata and changed future search, but installed procedures were not represented in a general executable IR.
boundary_findings.hidden_evaluator: Hidden ProgramTestCase evaluation existed and was outside method selection.
boundary_findings.task_generator: Recursive protocol directly selected task families; the experiment author still controlled task sequencing.
boundary_findings.library: CapabilityLibrary/history existed, but learned method programs were not a first-class compositional library.
boundary_findings.representation: UniversalProgram/UExpr/UStmt provided one executable representation; representation revision was not itself in a unified search substrate.
boundary_findings.synthesis_ir: UniversalProgram was executable for task programs but not for acquisition procedures.
boundary_findings.planner: SearchPlanner/UniversalMechanismSearch handled task mechanism search; acquisition-method search was separate.
boundary_findings.self_model: SelfModel stored capabilities/gaps/failures but did not causally predict method applicability from held-out evidence.
boundary_findings.critical_leak: The old method path selected method semantics through named Go branches; this was the primary hidden cognitive decision at the recursion boundary.

replacement.bootstrap_privilege: only primitive opcode semantics; no privileged method-name selection
replacement.recursive_edge: verified executable method is registered as a library object and can be invoked by later executable methods
replacement.abstraction: repeated instruction suffixes can be mined into a retained executable abstraction
replacement.known_limit: the bootstrap primitive vocabulary and available UniversalMechanismSearch strategies are still human-specified
